authorization: Root approved this minimal permitted recipe amendment before implementation on 2026-10-10. Independent generic review remains pending. No source/build/model/task execution authorized by this design receipt.
amended_sections: closed unavailable reason enum in selection/view schema
normative_changes: Replace mandatory per-expression proof-tree emission with one exact universal compiled-entry/helper equality per function. The source renderer still structurally traverses and records type/binder/layout metadata; that proposal metadata is not semantic authority.

First recipe is fixed `intro env; with_unfolding_all rfl` for the exact forall-env equality. For RunEquals with canonical fields, fixed constructors provide exact params/result equalities, then the same forall-env rfl recipe. This kernel checks the entire actual function, every runtime Env, exact helper/entry lookup and original compiler. A source-level nominal/signature/lookup guard is still kernel-checked.

Closed normalization here means conversion of finalized source/profile/helper scheduling/shape/cast/environment compiler administration to exact total symbolic run functions. It does not execute chosen runtime sample arguments or finite cases and does not generate accepted-reference/guarantee/refinement proofs. Kernel definitional conversion may reduce source-closed mathematical terms under existing frozen compile/kernel resource policy; no successful unbounded normalization or runtime time bound is asserted.

No arbitrary proof search, tactic synthesis, broad cbv optimization, manual source/proof repair, per-task lemma or model call. Preserve exact compiler-selected primitives and source expression order so proposed functions can be definitionally equal. Existing adapter/raw laws may be applied by a deterministic registered wrapper recipe.

If fixed kernel conversion cannot establish a universal equality, the optional proposal is OPTIONAL_UNAVAILABLE before proof freeze, with explicit reported diagnostic inventory and unchanged admitted BASE fallback. Status is REJECTED for correspondence failure, UNSUPPORTED for deterministic view budget, INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE for isolated tooling/resource failure. Existing four support statuses are unchanged. Frozen CHECKED replay never falls back.

Targeted already registered named generic helper/transport laws are permitted only as an explicit closed deterministic recipe variant, identified by catalog hash and exact term-generation rule before its use/qualification. Missing variants remain unavailable; an agent never invents a task proof to complete them.

Do not require inventories for per-expression proof declarations when none are emitted. Exhaustively audit every actually emitted definition/theorem/auxiliary and any registered generic support module, including unused declarations. Expected emitted inventory remains exact and closed. Universal laws, source-only independence, MODULE_BOUND_PROOF, exact definition body hashes, original obligation/transfer/raw/axiom policies and all selected replay/certificate/closure binding rules remain mandatory.

The constructor matrix is a structural semantics/correspondence checklist, not a requirement to emit one theorem per AST node. Every supported constructor still needs positive whole-function universal kernel validation and meaningful mutation coverage in fresh unrelated generic cases.

Future closed reason code enums add OPTIONAL_UNAVAILABLE in both selection and view schemas. It is a reason/outcome label, never a lifecycle or success status. Original detailed TIMEOUT/OOM/OUTPUT_BUDGET/etc reasons are retained alongside it.
finite_implementation_plan: One typed source-rendering pass returns source type plus Lean expression with explicit de Bruijn binder stack, precise scalar/list operations and exact shape/layout resolver. No accepted body inputs.
Named helper and entry definitions preserve sharing. readable_run faces declared-order Env and applies envReverse; readable_named builds the exact declared-order tuple.
Generate actual compiled lookup/signature aliases and a single universal RunEquals/equation per helper/entry, then unchanged accepted adapter/raw wrapper equations.
Try the fixed source-derived universal kernel recipe in a separate optional build after base admission. Exhaustive current kernel exports, exact source/module hashes and inventories gate CHECKED.

Implement schema/packet/certificate/evidence and selected replay through all current materialization/link/verification/closure paths, with telemetry consumption but no overlap with its helper ownership.

validation_delta.required_positive: Fresh nested record/Option/List/map/fold/let/helper capture and scalar cases pass the exact universal rfl route, or are honestly unavailable; no completed coverage claim until all declared positives pass.
validation_delta.required_negative: Typable same-sort parameter, helper argument, list-fold item/acc, Nat-fold index/acc swaps must fail universal kernel conversion. Unused support and same-type theorem source/module substitution still audited.

unchanged_parent_requirements: Every v2.1 requirement not explicitly amended here remains normative; this receipt supplies no implementation/qualification claim.
